fields.name: stayed
fields.description:
True when nothing moved because the sign-in was a silent one (the
IAM's sign-in hint) and the account already has something here: the
visitor stays as it was, and its key still opens it on this browser
(the owner's decision of 2026-10-11). Everything else is then 0.

shapes.name: WeaponAscensionFull
shapes.description:
One ascension phase, with the materials it costs.

registerFullResource() merges a child's own children in beside its columns
rather than nesting them under a key, so this is a WeaponAscension with one
more field - which is what `@merges` says.
